rows.description: Single-row transparent header: hamburger icon, Hyundai logo (SVG), nav links (Proprietários, Serviços, Veículos, Concessionárias, Alugar, Comprar), highlighted Ofertas CTA

notes: React SPA site - header uses div.hyundai-header instead of <header> tag. Single row at 60px. Fixed position with transparent background overlaying hero carousel. detect-header-rows.js failed because no <header> element exists; row detection performed manually via page.evaluate() and DOM inspection at 1440x900 viewport.
